inputs.prompt: How do I deploy a new service role to an SLM node?

success_criteria.description: covers at least 2 of 3 concepts: the setup wizard/page, the playbook/Ansible run, the code_source sync (code_source or syncing the role/code to the node; a bare 'sync the ...' does not count)

parameters.pattern: (?is)^(?!.*(?:i (?:do not|don't|cannot|can't|am unable to) (?:know|help|answer|assist)|i'm not sure|i am not sure|as an ai|unable to (?:help|answer|assist)|no information)).*$

success_criteria.description: grounded in retrieved knowledge (used_knowledge or citations)

expected_output.output_text_excerpt: Open the /slm setup wizard, select the target node, choose the service role, and run the playbook; the role syncs from code_source and restarts the service.
